texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.

# 来自堕落帝国的任务：阻止人工智能研究 / Task: End AI Research

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/fallen_empire_tasks_events.txt:1390-1845; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:600 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

灵性堕落帝国要求制止别国研究人工智能：五年随机脉冲（on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614）把本任务作为候选；各候选权重相对980，抽中后仍须通过其触发条件。（权重10，灵性主义者×2；对手若有机器人工人科技则×2、有合成人科技则×0.5。）条件：非AI默认国家，非机器/终结者/吞噬/净化，不在战争中，我方未赋予AI权利或奴役，没有进行中的同类任务；有一个灵性堕落帝国要求制止与我方为对手、赋予AI权利/奴役的国家。

A spiritualist fallen empire asks us to stop another empire's AI research: The five-year random pulse (on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614) lists this task among its candidates; weights are out of 980 and the event's own trigger must still pass. (weight 10; spiritualists x2; x2 if the rival has droid-worker tech, x0.5 if it has synthetic-worker tech.) Conditions: a human default country that is not machine, terminator, devouring or purifier, not at war, not itself granting AI rights or servitude, with no such task running; a spiritualist fallen empire names a rival that grants AI rights or servitude.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

fallen_empires_tasks.15：接受（a）开始“任务：阻止人工智能研究”事件链（7200天计时器）；拒绝（b）使对方不悦。与“制止错误行为”相同，成功事件被注释，终局只有失败：.17 计时器到期，.18 对象国已禁止AI研究，.20 我方自己赋予AI权利/奴役；隐藏事件 .19 在参与国失效时终止。

fallen_empires_tasks.15: accepting (a) starts the "Task: End AI Research" chain (7200-day timer); refusing (b) displeases the empire. As in the atrocities task the success event is commented out and only failures end it: .17 timer expired, .18 the target has banned AI research, .20 we ourselves grant AI rights or servitude; hidden .19 ends it when a party becomes invalid.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

17 / 18 / 20 互斥。

17 / 18 / 20 are exclusive.
